registers.name: CHIP_ID
registers.description: Chip identification register, fixed value 0x55 (p18: 'Chip-id (register D0h): This value is fixed to 0x55')

registers.name: SOFT_RESET
registers.description: Soft reset register, write-only (p18: 'Soft reset (register E0h): Write only register. If set to 0xB6, will perform the same sequence as power on reset.')

registers.name: CTRL_MEAS
registers.description: Measurement control register (p18: 'Measurement control (register F4h <4:0>): Controls measurements'). Bits [4:0]=measurement control, bit [5]=SCO start-of-conversion, bits [7:6]=OSS oversampling.

registers.name: OUT_MSB
registers.description: ADC output data MSB (p22: 'Temperature or pressure value UT or UP 0xF6 (MSB)')

registers.name: OUT_XLSB
registers.description: ADC output data XLSB for ultra high resolution pressure (p18: 'out_xlsb F8h', p22: 'optionally 0xF8 (XLSB)')

commands.name: SOFT_RESET
commands.purpose: Perform power-on-reset sequence (p18: 'If set to 0xB6, will perform the same sequence as power on reset')

commands.name: READ_TEMPERATURE
commands.purpose: Start uncompensated temperature measurement (p21 Table 8: Temperature 0x2E, 4.5ms max)

commands.name: READ_PRESSURE_OSS0
commands.purpose: Start uncompensated pressure measurement, oversampling=0 (p21 Table 8: 0x34, 4.5ms max)

commands.name: READ_PRESSURE_OSS1
commands.purpose: Start uncompensated pressure measurement, oversampling=1 (p21 Table 8: 0x74, 7.5ms max)

commands.name: READ_PRESSURE_OSS2
commands.purpose: Start uncompensated pressure measurement, oversampling=2 (p21 Table 8: 0xB4, 13.5ms max)

commands.name: READ_PRESSURE_OSS3
commands.purpose: Start uncompensated pressure measurement, oversampling=3 (p21 Table 8: 0xF4, 25.5ms max)

timings.name: temperature_conversion
timings.description: Max conversion time for temperature (p7/p21 Table 8: 4.5ms)

timings.name: pressure_oss0_conversion
timings.description: Max conversion time for pressure OSS=0 (p12 Table 3 / p21 Table 8: 4.5ms)

timings.name: pressure_oss1_conversion
timings.description: Max conversion time for pressure OSS=1 (p12 Table 3 / p21 Table 8: 7.5ms)

timings.name: pressure_oss2_conversion
timings.description: Max conversion time for pressure OSS=2 (p12 Table 3 / p21 Table 8: 13.5ms)

timings.name: pressure_oss3_conversion
timings.description: Max conversion time for pressure OSS=3 (p12 Table 3 / p21 Table 8: 25.5ms)

timings.name: soft_reset_time
timings.description: Wait after soft reset — same as startup time (p19 Table 6: tStart min 10ms)

timings.name: startup_time
timings.description: Power-on startup time before first communication (p19 Table 6: tStart min 10ms)

meta.extraction_method: blind PDF extraction (PyMuPDF text, BST-BMP180-DS000-12 Rev 2.8)
meta.extractor_notes: Extracted from Bosch BMP180 datasheet. Register map from p18 Figure 6 / text. Calibration from p13 Table 5. Commands from p21 Table 8. Timings from p7 Table 1 and p12 Table 3. Signed/unsigned for calibration coefficients inferred from API code convention (AC1-AC3 signed, AC4-AC6 unsigned, B1-B2 signed, MB-MC-MD signed) — datasheet Table 5 does not explicitly state signedness. I2C address 0x77 from p20 Table 7 (0xEE/0xEF → 7-bit 0x77).
